name: product-spec
description: Take a product idea to a buildable spec in seven gated phases: discovery with locked decisions, a PRD with Given/When/Then requirements, the data schema, UI screens, architecture, an agent roster with a sprint backlog checked by code, and navigable mockups. Includes the operational readiness track (legal, banking, app stores) and the product advisor. Stack-agnostic: Flutter + Firebase or FastAPI + React.
